tc.book.body.0:
Craft two iron caps and attach them to a stick.

Use the wand on a bookshelf. The shelf becomes a Thaumonomicon. Pick up the book and right-click to read it.
tc.book.recipe.0:
Cap: five iron nuggets.
Wand: two caps and a stick, arranged diagonally.
tc.book.body.1:
Mine infused stone with an iron pickaxe for shards.

Hold use while aiming at a block, dropped item or creature. Keep the same target until the scan completes.
tc.book.recipe.1:
Thaumometer: glass, two iron ingots and any two shards.

Discover both components before studying a compound aspect. Repeated scans give no points.
tc.book.body.2:
Place two tables next to each other and use scribing tools.

Tools: phial, feather, black dye.

Eight phials: clay above, glass to the left, right and below.
tc.book.recipe.2:
Each combination spends one point of each component.

Terra + Aqua = Victus
Victus + Terra = Herba
Aer + Herba = Arbor
